source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the date, time, and location of the audit.
3. List the members of the audit team and their qualifications.
4. Describe any shoddy equipment or equipment with maintenance issues.
5. Identify any neglected or broken safety guards or PPE (Personal Protective Equipment).
6. Cite any gaps in compliance with industry safety standards and regulations.
7. Note instances of non-compliance with internal safety policies and protocols.
8. Use a checklist approach to ensure comprehensive coverage of all safety aspects.
9. Include photographs or diagrams where appropriate, illustrating issues for clarity.
10. Record any comments or explanations provided by employees or management regarding safety issues.
11. Document any unsafe work practices observed during the audit.
12. Summarize and list the causes of each safety violation.
13. Provide recommendations for remedial action along with a suggested timeline for correction.
14. Attach any relevant supporting documentation (e.g. maintenance records, prior audit reports, written
